verdict.rationale: Linear documents native first-party integrations for GitHub (PR automation, issue sync, review in Linear) and Slack (create issues from messages, synced threads, notifications, loop-posted messages), plus a broad integration directory including Figma, Notion and Datadog. Google Drive, one of the three named tools, never appears in the evidence. An older community report called the Slack integration non-existent, but that predates the current documented Slack issue-creation feature, so it does not contradict it. Missing for 10: any evidence of a native Google Drive integration, independent hands-on corroboration of the current Slack/GitHub integrations.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Connect GitHub to automate PR workflows, review code in Linear, sync issues and understand your codebase with Linear Agent
Create issues from Slack messages and sync threads
Added ability to subscribe to events in project views and receive notifications in Inbox or Slack
You can now assign reviews to GitHub teams. Review requests assigned to your GitHub teams appear in a dedicated section of the Reviews inbox.
